name: vawe-night
note: THE BRAND AFTER DARK, for the launch film. Derived from themes/vawe.json, not invented, and deliberately NOT vawe-dark: that ships accent #5ee0c8, and near-black plus one teal accent is the exact look this project's own design read rules out. vawe.json already solved the dark case in prose: 'cobalt on #0f1620 is ~2.5:1 and unreadable. Two-surface accent: cobalt on light, ice-blue #8fc0ff on a charcoal code slab.' So this carries TWO blues at two roles rather than one flat accent. #8fc0ff is the readable accent on the ground; the real brand cobalt #2563eb survives as the caret and the glow, where it is a light source rather than something to read. The ground is #0d1117, cool rather than neutral, so it belongs to the blue rather than sitting under it.
